## Below-Market Pay Hampering Samsung's Staffing of US Taylor Fab Ahead of Production Ramp

Fab staffing constraints ahead of ramp represent an execution risk for Samsung Foundry's US capacity build — material for customers counting on Taylor output, and a read-through for TSMC's relative positioning in the US advanced manufacturing race.

- Compensation levels are reported to be impeding Samsung's ability to attract dispatch workers to its Taylor, Texas fabrication facility.
- The staffing shortfall could delay or complicate the fab's planned production ramp.
- No specific timeline, production targets, or magnitude of shortfall are provided in the headline.
- This adds execution-risk color to the broader Samsung US fab buildout narrative.
